overview:
**Fire danger is High today across the Montrose (High Elevation) area, driven by warm temps and dropping humidity as fuels continue to dry out.**
- Danger climbs through the week, reaching Very High by Saturday, Aug 3, as ERC and BI percentiles rise steadily.
- Afternoon storms are possible today, but humidity falls into the high-teens by the weekend with winds picking up to 9-10 mph from the NNE.
- No Red Flag Warning is active, and 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are currently met.
Stage 1 fire restrictions remain in effect on BLM-administered public lands in Gunnison, Hinsdale, Montrose, Ouray, Saguache, and San Juan counties, plus Delta, Mesa and San Miguel counties.
- The Gold Mountain Fire near Ouray is at 38,063 acres and 37% contained, with the Elk Fire smoldering near Lake City and the Ferris Fire holding near Cahone.
